Name: Large Greenhouse with Veranda (PIF)
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[size=5][color=#ffff00]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/color]
[/size]
[size=3]From a cute idea by [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3082852]PixieTJ  [/url][size=3], [/size]whom I thank[size=3], I created this double-entry large greenhouse for the porch behind the glass, where you can plant trees, tea seedlings or crops on the porch as well. This [/size][size=3]greenhouse[/size][size=3] remains this size. Lots of space for planting!
You can change the floors any way you want, it has a working fountain as a water source inside, and the water on the veranda is also real.
I love it already!  [color=#ff0000]<3[/color][/size]

[size=3]There is an optional version for those with obsessive compulsive disorder, or you use one version or the other.[/size]

[size=3]Installation:
Unzip and paste into Stardew Valley Mods folder.

How do you go about getting it ingame?
You buy any door as long as it is PIF-enabled, hang it on the wall, choose the room, and go inside.
This doesn't replace the game's greenhouse.
I created PIF glass doors that are purchased from Robin's store [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28160]here[/url]
Enjoy!

Remember to install the dependencies or it will not work properly.

The art of this beautiful fountain was created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/182201142]TangaS2[/url] and animated by me.

[/size][color=#00ffff][size=5]Thank you all for your support! It encourages me to create and share new mods. <3[/size][/color]
[size=3][size=3]
Maybe you might be interested in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181358142?tab=user+files]Mods[/url][/size]
[/size]
If you appreciate my work you can donate me a [size=3]coffee[/size][size=3]?[/size][size=3] [url=https://ko-fi.com/kanacane]Ko fi
[/url][/size][size=3]
Here is my Discord server. https://discord.gg/PEHYyagv6T
[/size]
